title: Sandustry Cheats: Are There Cheat Codes? Early Access
description: Looking for Sandustry cheats or console commands? The honest Early Access answer, what official sources document, and legit alternatives in Sandustry.
h1: Sandustry Cheats: What Actually Exists in Early Access

sections.h2: Are there official Sandustry cheat codes?
paragraphs: As of the latest Steam listings and the official Hooded Horse wiki, Sandustry has no published cheat codes, console-command list, or developer-sanctioned cheat menu. The official wiki does not document a cheats section, and neither the full-game nor the free demo Steam listing mentions built-in cheats. Players who search the Discord or r/SandustryGame for codes generally get the same answer: the developers have not released any.

That does not mean the topic is closed. Sandustry is in Early Access and receives frequent updates, so an undocumented feature could appear in a later patch. Treat any 'unlock code' found on a third-party site as unverified unless it turns up on official channels.

sections.h2: What to use instead of cheats
paragraphs: The Steam store page positions Sandustry as a relaxed, open-ended factory game with no combat and no failure timer, so there is no high-stakes moment where a cheat would be needed. To practice ideas risk-free, the free Sandustry demo on Steam is the sanctioned way to experiment before committing to a full build.

For most goals people chase with cheats, the practical route is faster: our tips page covers first-hour habits, the automation page explains scaling a factory, and the slag page handles the byproduct that trips up new players. None of these require codes, and all of them work in the current build.

sections.h2: Where to check before trusting any cheat claim
paragraphs: The reliable places to verify cheat-related claims are the official Sandustry wiki on Hooded Horse's site, the official Discord, and r/SandustryGame, where the community flags fake codes quickly. Websites promising 'Sandustry unlock codes' or save editors are not endorsed by the developer and are often outdated guesswork; treat them with caution.

If a YouTube video claims to show cheats, check the patch date first. Early Access builds change rapidly, and a command that worked in one weekly patch can vanish in the next. Our early-access page tracks how current any Sandustry information can realistically be, and it is worth a look before you trust a dated claim.

note: Patch-sensitive: Early Access updates change mechanics often. No cheat codes were documented on official channels when this page was written; if that changes, refresh against the official wiki rather than third-party code lists.
